artworks.title: James Graham, First Marquess of Montrose
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the upper half. The person faces forward with a slight turn to the right, holding a staff in their right hand with their left arm resting on a ledge. They have a serious expression with a slight smile, a mustache, and long, curly hair past their shoulders. The person is depicted wearing armor, a large belt, and a sash on their torso. The background has lined engravings, and the portrait is within a framed border. There is an inscription at the bottom with text detailing the person's titles and the name of the engraver.

artworks.title: Sir John Moore
artworks.artist: James MacArdell after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The image depicts a man sitting in an armchair. He has long hair, a serious expression, and is wearing a robe with fur trim, a patterned vest, and a lace cravat. There is a chain draped over his shoulders, and the chair has floral patterns. In the background, there is a tapestry and a crown on a pedestal.

artworks.title: Alexander Morus
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the waist up, seated in a slightly turned position. He has a full face with a mustache and a small goatee, shoulder-length curly hair, and is wearing a traditional 17th-century outfit with a dark robe featuring a white collar and cuffs. His right hand is resting on his chest while his left hand is placed on what looks like the edge of a table or a chest covered with a patterned cloth. There are no visible pieces of jewelry on him, nor any objects he appears to be holding. The background includes draped curtains on the left and a detailed wall surface to the right. Text beneath the image contextualizes the portrait.

artworks.title: Alexander More
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a seated pose from the waist up. He has one hand resting on a surface with a patterned cloth and the other hand on his chest. He has a mustache, a small pointed beard, wide eyes, wavy shoulder-length hair, and is dressed in period-appropriate attire with a wide-collared shirt and a dark cloak or gown. The background features columns and elegant drapery, suggesting a refined environment.

artworks.title: John More, Rector of Saint Andrew's, Norwich
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: This is a portrait of a man's upper body. The man is facing slightly to his right, with his gaze directed towards the viewer. He has a full beard and mustache, a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and short hair mostly covered by a wide-brimmed hat. He is wearing a coat with a fur collar. There is a crosshatch pattern in the background. Below the portrait is text likely identifying the person.

artworks.title: Sir Thomas More
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man seated facing to the right. His facial features are notable for their solemn expression, with wrinkles visible on his forehead, deep-set eyes, and a defined nose. The man is wearing a fur-trimmed robe, and a decorative flower-shaped brooch on the left side of his chest. His hair is mostly covered by a dark, flat hat typical of the period, with only a slight fringe visible. The background is a textured pattern. Below the portrait, there is a text providing information about the person depicted, including his name, "Thomas Morus."

artworks.title: Sir Thomas More, Lord Chancellor
artworks.description: The image is a detailed, historical engraving of a man from the waist up. He is seated, facing slightly to the right, with his hands in front of him. One hand holds a scroll. The man has a serious expression, straight nose, prominent chin, and his eyes are looking to the right. He wears a cap, and his clothing includes a fur-lined robe, an elaborate chain of office on his shoulders, and an ornate badge at the front. Additional elements in the image include a scroll, a coat of arms or emblem, two small birds, and decorative designs in the background. Surrounding the image is Latin text.

artworks.title: Sir Thomas More, Lord Chacellor
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man with distinct facial features, seated and slightly turned to the side. He wears a robe with a fur-trimmed collar and holds a rolled-up scroll in his left hand while pointing to it with his right hand. Below the portrait is text that identifies him.

artworks.title: Balthasar Moretus of Antwerp
artworks.description: The portrait shows an upper-body view of a man seated in profile, facing to the right of the image. He has a refined facial profile with a mustache and a short beard, and his hair is neatly combed and short. He wears a garment with a large, ornate ruffled collar and what appears to be a cloak with visible folds and intricate detailing. The man’s hands are visible, resting on a surface that looks like a stack of books, with some decorative elements visible on the book covers. In the background, a pattern of vertical lines suggests a textured wall that adds depth to the engraving. There is text below the image with information, presumably about the man, including his name and some Latin inscriptions.

artworks.title: Philippe de Mornay (Du Plessis-Mornay)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait cut from the chest up of a man with an oval frame surrounding him. He is positioned to the side but faces the viewer directly with a confident posture. His facial features include a prominent brow, a well-defined nose, and a beard that is short and well-kept, with his hair appearing curly and voluminous. He's wearing a richly textured and patterned garment typical of a renaissance or early modern period, featuring elaborate embroidery or brocade and puffed sleeves with a high collar. There is no visible jewelry on him, and he is not holding any objects. The background includes ornate, detailed patterns within the oval frame. The outer part of the oval frame is inscribed with Latin text that reads "ANNO AETATIS LXII. M.DC.XI." and "ARTE ET MARTE."

artworks.title: Henry, Duc de Moutpensier
artworks.description: The image shows a man in historical attire with elaborate armor, facing forward. He has a mustache, beard, styled hair, and wears a high ruff collar. The background includes an oval frame with text, and below the portrait is calligraphic writing.

artworks.title: Vincent Muschinger
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man depicted from the waist up. He is positioned with his body angled slightly to the viewer's right, with his head turned towards the viewer and a direct gaze. The man has a mustache, a full beard, short styled back hair, and is wearing a Renaissance-style garment with a large collar. His attire includes a richly patterned fabric, and he wears a chain with a pendant or medallion around his neck. The background features an ornate oval frame with inscriptions, decorative elements, and a coat of arms in the corners.

artworks.title: Napier of Merchiston, Inventor of Logarithms
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a man named Napier of Merchiston. He is portrayed facing slightly to his left within an ornate oval frame decorated with leaves and botanical designs. His facial features include a well-groomed beard and mustache, dark eyes, and dark hair covered by a cap. He wears a dark coat with a high, wide collar, possibly made of luxurious material. Beneath the frame, there is a family crest and an inscription highlighting Napier of Merchiston's role in inventing logarithms. The background is plain, with a symbolic depiction of a single eye surrounded by rays at the top. The paper appears aged and textured.

artworks.title: Matthew Parker
artworks.description: The image shows an older man seated, visible from the waist up in a formal pose. His hands are resting on a book and writing materials on a table in front of him. His facial features include a prominent nose, thin lips, and a serious expression. He has short hair under a cap and a bushy mustache that extends down the sides of his mouth. The man is dressed in traditional clerical attire with a high-collared shirt, a vestment, and a cap. On the table are an open book, a quill, an inkpot, and other scholarly items. The background features a room with an ornate circular window to the right, casting shadows suggested through the linear detailing in the etching. The room's walls and furniture are intricately detailed with wood lines.

artworks.title: Sir Robert Naunton, Secretary of State for James I
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a seated position, showing his upper body. He has defined facial features, including a high forehead, arched eyebrows, deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a pointed beard with a well-groomed mustache. His hair is short and receding at the temples. He is dressed in a dark, elaborately patterned garment with a high, stiff lace collar. The background is plain, with an ornate coat of arms to the right of his head. The image is a historical engraving, with text identifying the man as Sir Robert Naunton and providing details on the engraver and the source of the painting.

artworks.title: Carolus van Utenhoven
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of an old man from the waist up. He stands in a slightly angled position facing left. The man has a full white beard and mustache, deep-set eyes, curly hair, and a contemplative expression. He wears a period costume with a high ruffled collar and a doublet with buttons. He holds a scroll in his right hand and rests his other hand on a closed book on a flat surface. The background has a simple, textured pattern. Below the portrait, there is a section of text in a stylized script.

artworks.title: Jan Nicquet
artworks.description: The image displays an upper body portrait of a man turned slightly to the left, with a stern expression, a beard and mustache. He has short, dark, wavy hair and wears a detailed ruff around his neck, a decorated doublet with buttons, and a cloak over his shoulders. The man's left hand holds a brush-like object. In the background is a coat of arms with a shield, heraldic symbols, a helmet with a plume, all against a patterned backdrop. The image is framed by a border with inscribed text along the upper and lower edges.

artworks.title: Sir John Norris
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of Sir John Norris. He is shown from the chest up, facing forward with his head turned slightly to his left. Sir John Norris has curly hair, a neatly trimmed beard and mustache, and a neutral facial expression. He wears an ornate garment with intricate embroidery on the shoulders and neckline. There is no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain, and the portrait is framed within an oval border. Below the portrait is a handwritten note with a signature reading "J. Norris" and printed text crediting the original artist and collection.

artworks.title: Henry Howard, Earl of Northampton
artworks.description: This image depicts the upper body of a man facing forward. He has a mustache and beard, high forehead, and smooth skin. His hair is short and possibly receding. He wears an ornate ruff collar, a patterned garment with buttons, a dark cloak, and a tall, flat-brimmed hat. He also wears a necklace with a medallion. The background has a textured appearance with a dotted or stippled pattern.

artworks.title: Henry Howard, Earl of Northampton
artworks.description: A portrait of a man from the waist up. He is facing slightly towards the viewer, with a pointed beard and mustache, along with medium-length hair mostly covered by a tall, dark hat. He wears a patterned ruffled collar, a patterned vest or doublet under a dark cloak, and a chain with a pendant around his neck. The background is textured and dark.

artworks.title: Henry Howard, Earl of Northampton
artworks.description: The image displays a man's portrait from the chest up. He is seated and facing slightly to the right. He has a neatly trimmed beard and mustache, arched eyebrows, dark eyes, short groomed hair partly covered by a large hat. He wears an intricate ensemble with a high ruffled collar, ornamental patterns, and precise stitching designs. The background is plain without any additional details or objects.

artworks.title: Charles Howard, First Earl of Nottingham
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing upright with a composed expression. He has a beard, mustache, short hair, and wears an elaborate hat with feathers. His outfit includes a cloak, doublet, and breeches, all ornately adorned. He wears a chain with a medallion and holds a sword. The background features an architectural arch and a pastoral scene with hills, a bridge, and a river.

artworks.title: Alexander Nowell, Dean of Saint Paul's
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image depicts an older man from the waist up, seated and facing slightly to his left. He has a prominent forehead, deep-set eyes, a long, thin nose, short cropped beard and mustache, and closely cropped hair covered by a cap. He is wearing a fur-collared coat over an ornate garment with visible buttons. There is no visible jewelry. The background consists of finely detailed lines and cross-hatching, with no specific elements. At the bottom of the portrait, there is a written inscription identifying the person as Alexander Nowell.

artworks.title: Matthias de L'Obel
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man seated within an ornate frame. His features include a broad forehead, prominent eyebrows, a mustache, and a beard. His hair is sparse on top but fuller on the sides and beard. The man wears a dark garment with a high collar and holds a plant in his right hand. The background features carvings, cherubic figures above the frame, and floral motifs. Text is inscribed around what appears to be an oval frame, and the background resembles architectural elements.
